claims.text: In the USA, 97.2% of city residents have safe sanitation. In Colombia, it's 7.2%.
American cities sit near the highest coverage, but vast differences exist elsewhere.
India has 55.8% of urban residents covered, sitting right near the global median.
Brazil hits 56.6%, while Nigeria drops down to 36.8% of city dwellers.
At the bottom, Madagascar has 16.7%, DR Congo has 15.2%, and Armenia is the world's lowest at 0%.
It counts city residents using unshared facilities where waste is safely disposed of or treated offsite.
claims.support: The percentage of people using improved sanitation facilities that are not shared with other households and where excreta are safely disposed of in situ or transported and treated offsite.
